malaclaw.note: Pinned in CI to the immutable commit behind release v2.3.0 (a tag is mutable, and CI runs npm lifecycle scripts against whatever it checks out). The pin moves on MalaClaw releases, not commits. Requires >=2.3.0 for semantic workflow phases, per-stage model reasoning effort, recoverable action dispatch, and race-safe dashboard continuation.

sdk.note: The SDK ships as the ./sdk subpath export of the malaclaw package, not as a separate @malaclaw/sdk. It imports the engine's canonical Zod IR, so splitting it out would either duplicate that schema or load two zod instances. MrMaLiang resolves it from the checked-out runtime at .dependencies/MalaClaw.
